featured_verses.description: Verse of the day rotation: references like "PSA 46:10" or "LAM 3:22-23" using the app's 3-letter book ids.

announcement.description: Short message for users; empty means none.

card_styles.description: Card style changes: "order" and "hidden" take style ids (vigil, riso, dawn, swiss, night-watch, cobalt-arch); "styles" maps an id to name, tags, hidden_variants and variants (id plus hex colours: background, ink, accent, surface, ...). {} means as bundled. See lib/cards/card_style_overrides.dart.
